# Starfield (`starfield`)

Fly through an endless field of stars.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: medium (~5.0 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Hyperspace

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 3 | 1 |
| `density` | Density | slider | 4 … 40 | 12 |
| `warp` | Warp | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.3 |
| `size` | Star Size | slider | 0.3 … 3 | 1 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Background | {"r":0,"g":0,"b":0} |
| `colorB` | Foreground | {"r":1,"g":1,"b":1} |
